events.title: Marlow begins his tale on the Nellie
events.summary: On the Thames, Marlow tells his fellow sailors about his journey to the Congo, reflecting on the darkness of imperialism.

events.title: Marlow secures a job as a steamboat captain
events.summary: Through his aunt's influence, Marlow is appointed captain of a steamboat for a Belgian trading company in the Congo.

events.title: Marlow arrives at the Outer Station
events.summary: Marlow reaches the company's first station in Africa, witnessing the brutal exploitation and inefficiency of the colonial enterprise.

events.title: Marlow first hears of Kurtz
events.summary: At the Central Station, Marlow learns about the remarkable agent Kurtz, who is highly productive in ivory trading and admired by the company.

events.title: Marlow's steamboat is wrecked
events.summary: Marlow discovers his steamboat has been deliberately sunk, delaying his journey to Kurtz and revealing the manager's hostility.

events.title: Marlow finishes his story on the Nellie
events.summary: Marlow concludes his narrative, and the narrator reflects on the Thames, now seeming to lead into the heart of an immense darkness.
